_comment: Pinned official sources for the universal !Boot build. sha256 makes the build reproducible even though some URLs serve 'latest'. Re-pin (and re-verify the merge log) when bumping a version.

sources.name: HardDisc4
sources.role: disc-root: !Boot (all ROxxxHook incl. RO370Hook), Apps, Utilities. Bundles its own RO5-era !System at !Boot.Resources.!System.

sources.name: PlingSystem
sources.role: System resources: disc-based module sets 310/350/360/370/400. Merged into HardDisc4's !System, newest-version-wins.

sources.name: PartMgr
sources.role: Partition Manager 1.05-1 (JASPP repo). Disc partitioning/format tool.

sources.name: StrongED
sources.role: StrongED 4.69f14 text editor (Fred Graute; 26/32-bit, runs on RISC OS 3.7). Not in ROOL packaging.

sources.name: Zap
sources.role: Zap 1.45 text/hex editor CORE (26-bit-era stable; the newer 1.48.x needed a special 26-bit rebuild). Not in ROOL packaging. Core-only -- extension modules come from ZapExt below.

sources.name: ZapExt
sources.role: Zap 1.45 ALL extension modules (allmods.zip): !Zap/Modules/* -- the full 37-module set incl. !ZapBASIC, which claims the task-window server (Set TaskWindow$Server). Core zap.zip ships none, so without this task windows don't work and most modes are absent. Overlaid onto Apps/!Zap/Modules.

sources.name: MakeModes
sources.role: ROOL 'Bonus binaries' (maintained). Curated placement: !MakeModes (monitor definition files) from Utilities/Developer. ROOL-maintained preferred over the dead Acorn 0.26.

sources.name: AcornApps
sources.role: Acorn RISC OS 3.7 disc Apps (4corn Acorn-FTP archive, dead source). Curated placement: !ARPlayer only (the rest are already in HardDisc4).

sources.name: AcornUtils
sources.role: Acorn 3.7 Utilities (dead source). Curated placements: !SaveCMOS, !Verify, !PhotoView (skipped !CDPlayer/Access+/Patches; !HForm+!ResetBoot already in HardDisc4's Utilities.Caution -- ROOL wins).

sources.name: AcornDiversions
sources.role: Acorn 3.7 Diversions (games). content_merge: added where HardDisc4 lacks them (HardDisc4 always newer -> wins overlaps).

sources.name: AcornARMovie
sources.role: Acorn 3.7 ARMovie/Replay playback support (!Boot.Resources.!ARMovie etc.), needed by !ARPlayer. content_merge (add-missing, ROOL keeps its own).

sources.name: RpcemuBundle
sources.role: marutan.net RPCEmu 3.71 Easy-Start bundle (Other-Platforms ed.; disc content identical to the Windows ed.). The LOWEST-priority app source: used only where nothing more authoritative provides an app. Supplies !Browse + !WebCache/!WebServe (bundle-only apps -- placed WHOLE, never merged), Images/Video content, and period games in Diversions/ (each being migrated to its official download; bundle is the fallback). It also carries the URL fetcher modules Browse needs (FileFetcher/FTPFetcher in 310/Modules/Network/URL) that HardDisc4/PlingSystem lack -- pulled in via a legitimate !System merge (add-missing, so our newer authoritative URL/AcornHTTP/AcornSSL win). extract_only keeps just those subtrees out of the 116 MiB bundle.

sources.name: NetSurf
sources.role: NetSurf 3.11 -- a real CSS-capable browser that runs on RISC OS 3.7 (its !Run needs only 'RISC OS 3+' and uses CallASWI, so it's the single 26/32-neutral build for all RISC OS; the website's '4.02+' is mislabelled). Verified working on RO 3.7 (32 MB). Becomes the primary browser. !NetSurf -> Apps; its bundled !System (Iconv/Tinct/CryptRand/ARMEABISupport/URI/SharedULib) + !Boot (!Cache/!Unicode) deps are merged add-missing (ROOL keeps overlaps -- newer than NetSurf's minimums).

sources.name: PlingStore
sources.role: PlingStore (!Store) from its official site -- the RISC OS Developments app/software store (browse + buy commercial apps like Heretic). Fresh core (~250 KB) rather than the lived-in 5.9 MB copy in RpcemuBundle. !Store -> Apps.

_placements_comment: After HardDisc4 is laid down and !System merged, copy each app subtree from an extracted source (or from this repo) onto the disc. Paths are relative to each extracted source's root (post-strip). RaFS comes from this repo, already ,xxx-typed. The user-visible editors (!StrongED, !Zap) go in $.Apps; their satellite resource/config dirs go where each app's own !Run looks them up: !ZapFonts -> BootResources (!Boot.Resources), !ZapUser + !StrED_cfg -> Choices$Write (!Boot.Choices). See each app's Install doc / StartUp.SetupCfg.
_subtree_comment: The ONLY sanctioned merges: !System module sets and !Boot updates (never apps). Each named tree is merged add-missing (our more-authoritative HardDisc4/PlingSystem copy wins every overlap; only genuinely-missing modules/files are added). NetSurf ships its module deps this way; RpcemuBundle supplies Browse's FileFetcher/FTPFetcher; AcornARMovie is a !Boot.Resources update (!ARMovie playback support).
_content_place_comment: Non-!Boot/!System content (Acorn 3.7 games/sound/manuals). Each immediate child of the source's `container` dir is placed WHOLE onto the disc, but only where the authoritative disc (HardDisc4/ROOL) lacks that leafname. Whole apps only -- NEVER merged file-by-file (that spliced two !Flashers and duplicated !Help). ROOL keeps its whole app on every overlap; only Acorn-only extras are added.
_exclude_comment: Root files dropped from the assembled disc: non-essential docs, and their host '.' becomes a '/' in the RISC OS leaf name (harmless, but tidy to omit).
